name: Raffles Sentosa Singapore
short_description: Singapore's first all-villa resort, with 62 hilltop pool villas on Sentosa Island and a 4.1/5 ALL rating from around 400 reviews.
ai_summary: Raffles Sentosa Singapore is described on its own Accor listing as the first all-villa resort in Singapore, set on a hilltop on Sentosa Island with 62 pool villas surrounded by lush gardens. Interconnecting villas suit families or groups travelling together. The resort has six restaurants and bars, a Raffles Sentosa Spa, a fitness centre, and two ballrooms, one with a terrace overlooking the South China Sea. Accor's page shows a 4.1/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 398 reviews.

faqs.question: How many villas does Raffles Sentosa Singapore have?
faqs.answer: 62 pool villas, making it Singapore's first all-villa resort. Villas are set on a hilltop surrounded by gardens, with interconnecting options available for families or groups. The resort also has six restaurants and bars, a dedicated spa, a fitness centre, and two ballrooms, one with a terrace overlooking the South China Sea.
